name: Book Travelers II: A Royal Story Collector's Edition
detailed_description:
Elephant Games, the studio behind the groundbreaking Book Travelers: A Victorian Story brings you the next page-turning chapter, Book Travelers II: A Royal Story!

While reminiscing and recovering from the unbelievable events of your last adventure into the living pages of a literary classic, you soon find yourself summoned back to the Great Library. Once there, you realize that someone is trying to alter the world of the Three Musketeers and erase the enigmatic D'Artagnan from existence! You'll find yourself torn between reality and the universe within the celebrated novel as you unravel the mystery embedded in the words of author Alexandre Dumas and fight to ensure the future of the book's inhabitants! Do you have what it takes to fill the shoes of one of history's classic characters? Find out in this enthralling Hidden-Object puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

● Relive childhood memories in the Bonus Chapter!

● Collect busts of famous authors and find puzzle pieces to unlock a jigsaw puzzle in the Secret Room.

● Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games, earn achievements, and unlock an exclusive bonus chapter!

● Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, and more!

● Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
